[KINGVAPE - REFLASHED & UPDATED]
[2;32m[+][0m Reflashed Core: Whitelist and telemetry backdoors completely neutralized (immunity bypass, anti-crash, anti-remote uninject, no SelfReport)
[2;32m[+][0m Integrated EnemyBreakVisuals: real-time server block break & health visuals with pulse/shockwave
[2;32m[+][0m Integrated ESPSplit: generator resource analyzer with dropped item tracking, tier display & filters
[2;32m[+][0m Added ChargeSpoof (tells the server every swing was fully charged for instant max damage)
[2;32m[+][0m Added MultiJump (air jump bypasses without falling client penalties)
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoCollect (remote collection of kit items, souls, alchemy items, coins, seeds)
[2;32m[+][0m Added CollectableESP (renders all kit collectables on map with distance)
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoEnchant, AutoUpgrade, and AutoBedDefense automation
[2;32m[+][0m Added BlockBreakVisuals, AutoParry, SmartScaffold, and AutoManager
[2;33m[!][0m Reworked Nuker & TrapDisabler with optimized shortest-path algorithms
[BEDWARS]
[2;34m[*][0m Improved projectile prediction to learn repeated strafes and stop-start movement, and adapt its lead from previous prediction errors
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed ProjectileAimbot predicting from the wrong launch position and using the wrong speed for partially charged shots
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed stale movement estimates after stops, direction changes and teleports
[2;32m[+][0m Added Spectator check to AutoBank (holds your resources instead of banking while someone is spectating)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Patch to Block-In (using it again seals every gap left around you)
[2;32m[+][0m Added block skins to SkinChanger, Cannon included
[2;32m[+][0m Added Pearl, Whisper and Lasso checks to AutoReset (wont reset while you can still save yourself)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Last upgrade to AutoAdetunde (saves the upgrade you pick until the others are maxed)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Fury speed to Killaura (off keeps your normal swing spacing on a fury potion)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Shoot pots to ProjectileAimbot (aims splash potions separately from other projectiles)
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed Killaura skipping your swing animation while Swing only is on
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed Killaura swings ignoring your sword skin
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed RegionLock holding the loading screen forever when the server region could not be read
[2;34m[*][0m Improved RegionLock to list the regions BedWars actually hosts, with AUS, OCE and NZ counting as SEA
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed Nuker on Distance mode taking the nearest defense over the way into the bed, and changing target as you moved
[2;34m[*][0m Reworked BedESP to draw with the drawing library, with 2D and 3D modes, team names, health bars and the same options as ESP
[2;32m[+][0m Added Mode to AutoBank (On Void only banks your resources once you fall past the void line)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Owl Check to AutoBank (holds onto your resources while an owl is lifting you)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Auto Reset to AutoVoidDrop (resets as soon as your resources are dropped)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Charge attack to AutoSigrid (charges at whoever is in range while you ride the elk)
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed AutoReset resetting you right after you step off an edge, so you can clutch first
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed AutoKaida summoning at people through walls while Ignore behind walls was on
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed Killaura failing to turn on with Custom Animation when SilentAura was turned on first
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed PickupRange leaving items stuck and getting slower over a long match
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed RegionLock erroring when the script loads
[2;34m[*][0m Improved Nuker to find its way into beds faster behind big defenses
[2;34m[*][0m Improved Clutch to use less performance while you are standing still
[2;32m[+][0m Added BedDefense overlay (shows enemy bed defenses layer by layer)
[2;34m[*][0m Reworked AutoWin (better pathfinding, fighting patterns, etc)
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed Killaura, SilentAura and AutoChargeProj erroring after reinjecting
[2;34m[*][0m Improved Block-In placement speed on high ping
[2;34m[*][0m Improved projectile prediction to react to turns and stops sooner, and to hit jumping and running players more often
[2;34m[*][0m Improved hit registration for ProjectileAura, AutoShoot and Killaura's Projectiles option
[2;34m[*][0m Improved ProjectileAura, AutoLasso, AutoSophia and AutoWhim to hold fire when a block is in the way
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed ProjectileAura aiming about 3 studs too high at players on the ground
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed projectile prediction sometimes finding no shot at jumping players
[ILLEGAL SOCCER]
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoPlay (plays the match for you)
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoTeam (joins the side you pick)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Anti-AFK (stops idle kicks from matches)
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed ShotRedirect shots missing the chosen spot
[2;34m[*][0m Improved ShotRedirect accuracy and made it work at any camera angle
[2;34m[*][0m Improved ShotRedirect to keep full power on early releases
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed AutoGoalkeeper, AutoTackle, AutoCatch and AutoPowerup not moving you
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed AutoTackle and AutoGoalkeeper ignoring bot ball carriers
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed AutoDribble, TackleAssist and ShotRedirect after a game update
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed AutoPass and ShotRedirect conflicting when toggled
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed lag charging shots with PerfectShot and ShotRedirect on
[2;34m[*][0m Improved AutoPass to prefer open teammates
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoVolley (volleys balls flying at you with a shot, pass or lob)
[UNIVERSAL]
[2;34m[*][0m Improved ESP performance
[2;32m[+][0m Added BlurryTextures (pixelates game images)
[2;32m[+][0m Added FPS Cap to Wallhop (locks your FPS to 60 while it is on)
[GENERAL]
[2;34m[*][0m Improved performance over long matches, with less memory buildup and fewer lag spikes on weaker devices
[2;34m[*][0m Improved the module list to update without a hitch when modules toggle
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed the mobile Vape button going missing behind Roblox's buttons in matches
